The '''Clone mortar'''<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/carnage-of-krell-concept-art-gallery|text="Carnage of Krell" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref> was a short range weapon used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Its function was to drop explosive projectiles on enemies at a close distance. During the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] used the weapon to attack what they believed to be native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], but they later realized that they had been tricked into attacking their own men from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="Krell" />
